verdict.rationale: The Omarchy Menu groups installable software into categories such as Install > Development, Install > Terminal and Install > Windows, and lists familiar apps like VSCode, Cursor, Zed and Sublime Text. A community user also reports that installing software is easy and fast. However, nothing shows a searchable, filterable app catalog; the categories are fixed menu sections rather than a browsable store. Missing for 10: search within the app catalog, category filtering of a full app catalog, documentation of catalog breadth, independent hands-on corroboration of discovery workflows.
